events.content: Refreshed PR 3103, merged origin/main at b31cb2912, confirmed the live-state gate returned ACT, and acquired the pr-autofix lease.
Triaged two unresolved review threads: Windows Python and Git Bash used different /tmp files, and the extracted gate omitted infrastructure_failure=true.
Made the gate own one output path using AI_REVIEW_OUTPUT_FILE, RUNNER_TEMP, or tempfile.gettempdir. The action invoke and parse steps now consume the published output_file value.
Restored infrastructure_failure=true on the skip path and routed the composite action output through the gate result.
Added positive, negative, edge, sink, CLI, action-wiring, Linux Bash, and Windows job coverage. Code review found and fixed masked PowerShell failures plus an action-only path-filter gap.

Verification: uv run pytest reported 41 passed; the focused suite reached 98% module coverage; Ruff, mypy, Python 3.10 syntax, actionlint, gh act dry-run, YAML parsing, CWE-78 scan, pre_pr.py, security review, QA review, and final code review passed.
